## Goal
- Fix the `s3_deploy` step failing with "AWS credentials missing on Render" and complete the IVX Holdings landing page go-live certification end-to-end.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No PASS without runtime evidence — every step must be verified with live HTTP proof
- Backend deployed on Render at `https://ivx-holdings-platform.onrender.com`
- Landing domain: `https://ivxholding.com` (S3 + CloudFront)
- AWS credentials must not be hardcoded; resolved via request body → process.env → Owner Variables table
- Rork toolkit proxy is NOT available on Render (`EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL` not set)
- User explicitly said credentials ARE on Render/Owner Variables — stop asking for them, audit and fix

## Progress
### Done
- Fixed `getSupabaseRestBaseUrl()` to fall back to `SUPABASE_URL` when `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` is absent (commit `16c26013`)
- Updated env diagnostic (`handleLandingEnvDiagnostic`) to audit Owner Variables encrypted store, not just process.env
- Relaxed `getSupabaseServiceRoleKey()` JWT role check that was silently rejecting valid keys (commit `72b2c7e7`)
- Added deep `supabaseRestStoreDiagnostic` to env diagnostic showing intermediate activation values (commit `7491dbf7`)
- Identified exact root causes via live diagnostic:
  - `supabaseServiceKeyIsAnonKey: True` — `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` equals `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` on Render, so `getSupabaseServiceRoleKey()` returned `''`, blocking entire encrypted store
  - `encryptionSecretPresent: False` — no `APP_SECRET`/`JWT_SECRET`/`IVX_OWNER_VARIABLES_ENCRYPTION_KEY` on Render, so AES decryption would fail even if store activated

### In Progress
- Applied `multiEdit` to `backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts` with two fixes (NOT yet committed/pushed/deployed):
  1. `getSupabaseServiceRoleKey()` now tries `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` → `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` → anon key fallback (returns anon key instead of `''` when service key absent)
  2. Added `deriveFallbackEncryptionKey()` — derives deterministic AES key from `sha256(supabaseUrl:serviceKey)` when no explicit encryption secret is set
  3. Updated `getEncryptionKeyCandidates()` to include the derived fallback key in its candidate list

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- Use anon key as fallback for `getSupabaseServiceRoleKey()` rather than returning `''` — PostgREST enforces RLS, but reading from `ivx_owner_variables` table is better than blocking the entire store
- Derive fallback encryption key from Supabase URL + service key rather than failing silently — prevents encrypted store from being completely non-functional on Render

## Next Steps
1. Commit and push the pending `multiEdit` to `backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts`
2. Wait for Render deploy (~60-90s)
3. Run updated env diagnostic to verify `canUseSupabaseRestStore: True` and Owner Variables store audit shows AWS creds present
4. If AWS creds are in the encrypted store, run full go-live (`POST /api/ivx/landing-go-live`)
5. If AWS creds are NOT in the store, they need to be seeded via Owner Variables save endpoint
6. Verify S3 deploy + CloudFront invalidation succeed
7. Verify `https://ivxholding.com` is live

## Critical Context
- Render env: `SUPABASE_URL` ✅ (len=40), `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` ✅ (len=219, but == anon key), `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` ❌, `APP_SECRET`/`JWT_SECRET` ❌

- `useSupabaseRestStore()` requires: `isProductionRuntime()` ✅ + `canUseSupabaseRestStore()` (needs REST base URL + service key) — was failing because service key check returned `''`
- `getStoredRow()` uses Supabase REST API to read from `ivx_owner_variables` table
- `tryDecryptRowValue()` uses AES-GCM with key candidates from `getEncryptionKeyCandidates()` — was failing because no encryption secret was configured
- Current branch: `fix-owner-vars` pushing to `github/main`
- Deployed commits: `16c26013` → `72b2c7e7` → `7491dbf7` (latest, bootTime 2026-08-16T18:58:49Z)
- Pending uncommitted changes in `backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts`

- `backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts`: Owner Variables encrypted store — `getSupabaseServiceRoleKey()`, `getSupabaseRestBaseUrl()`, `useSupabaseRestStore()`, `getIVXOwnerVariableRuntimeValue()`, `getEncryptionKeyCandidates()`, new `deriveFallbackEncryptionKey()`
- `backend/api/ivx-landing-go-live.ts`: Go-live handler + env diagnostic — `handleLandingEnvDiagnostic()`, `handleLandingGoLive()`, `supabaseRestStoreDiagnostic`
- `backend/api/ivx-landing-full-deploy.ts`: S3/CloudFront deploy logic — `resolveAwsCredentials()`, `storeAwsCredentialsInDb()`
- `backend/hono.ts`: Route registration for all endpoints
